test_title: PYST 05: SSC JE CE - General Awareness (Held on 06 Jun 2024 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question:
Which of the following sentences is/are true?

i. After independence, about two-thirds of India’s population is now (2011 Census) literate.

ii. In India, between 2001 and 2011, male literacy rose faster than female literacy.

iii. Female literacy rose by about 10.4 per cent between 2001 and 2011 in India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only i and iii**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Option 4, which states that only statements i and iii are correct, is the right answer.
 
• **Statement i**: After independence, about two-thirds of India's population is now (2011 Census) literate. This statement is correct as per the 2011 Census data.
 
• **Statement iii**: Female literacy rose by about 10.4 per cent between 2001 and 2011 in India. This statement is also correct based on the statistical data from the 2001 and 2011 Census.
 
• **Statement ii**: In India, between 2001 and 2011, male literacy rose faster than female literacy. This statement is incorrect as female literacy actually rose faster than male literacy during this period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The literacy rate in India has been steadily increasing since independence, reflecting the country's efforts to improve education.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years and collects comprehensive data on various socio-economic parameters, including literacy rates.
 
• Government initiatives like the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan and the National Literacy Mission have significantly contributed to the rise in literacy rates.
 
• While the overall literacy rate has improved, there are still regional disparities and gender gaps that need to be addressed.
